results.title: Heart of the Hunter
results.overview: A retired assassin is pulled back into action when his friend uncovers a dangerous conspiracy at the heart of the South African government.

results.title: Building Me
results.overview: This film was shot over the course of one month, on a 10 year old camera, documenting empty construction sites. Through this, the filmmaker explores the beauty in humanity, growing up and the world of architecture.

results.title: Juk
results.overview: As her grandmother comes home from the nursing home, Kaya begins to resent her grandmother for being cruel to her mother.

results.title: Calber Island
results.overview: Discharged and isolated on a struggling island, Todd faces locals' resistance. When Viking history awakens, the blame falls on him and he's forced to battle prejudice, prepare for an ancient threat, and discover the power of change.

results.title: Last Date
results.overview: A husband going through a divorce learns his ex-wife is pushing for full custody of their daughter. How far will he go to keep his family together?

results.title: Flocks
results.overview: Valeria, an Afro-Finnish soccer player, becomes her team's new captain, dealing with pressure and conflicting emotions from others' expectations. Aurora, a non-binary worker, seeks their place but feels invisible. Nora looks for love but feels that she is only seen through her dark skin and curly hair. Rascist comments make her doubt her new crush's intentions. Selma gets trapped in tunnels during choir practice, confronting her fears in the darkness. Piera Niillas, a Saami activist, fights for a society free from oppression. The Quiet Man reflects on the diverse experiences of city life. The multi-story Flocks portrays minority experiences in contemporary Finland, touching on belonging, rejection, acceptance, and the complexities of Finnish identity and relationships. This fictional film sheds light on marginalized voices and societal issues, immersing characters and viewers in tense social realities.

results.title: 7 Times
results.overview: One afternoon a polite young boy, Elio, meets his tutor's secret lover. When he confides in her, sharing an even bigger secret, she's convinced he's joking and bursts out laughing.

results.title: JEIT
results.overview: Jeit Engranaje takes a journey through three phases. He must confront his inner demons and embrace death as a possibility for liberation from his hate: his spirit rises, leaving behind the darkness and embracing the light of freedom.

results.title: The Oracle
results.overview: Cris, a reclusive twenty-something, tries to hide from his aunt and uncle's family New Year's Eve party in a bathroom at the house. Here he will discover Paz, his enigmatic cousin, who invites him to read tarot cards in her peculiar and illuminated oracle, the bathtub.

results.title: The Shapeshifters
results.overview: An art collective experiments with ways to breach time and space and enter the infinity within the possible. But the instant is fleeting, and these moments quickly vanish. They must return to the political reality to which they are chained – bills to pay, a home to keep, jobs to hold, a possible play to produce.

results.title: Anwar
results.overview: Anwar is a sci-fi short film about a mother who chooses to live forever and a son who longs for heaven. We see Anwar age from 8 to 18 to 80, while Mona remains eternal throughout, until he has a final moment of doubt, and she has a final moment of hope.

results.title: Serbidoras
results.overview: Three servers who are willing to do everything to find their perfect mate. They are always ready to serve!

results.title: Stolen
results.overview: A young woman struggles to defend her Sámi heritage in a world where xenophobia is on the rise, climate change is threatening reindeer herding, and young people choose suicide in the face of collective desperation.

results.title: Himalaya
results.overview: A live investigation of the supernatural goes horribly wrong, unleashing a primitive Himalayan creature known as the Snow Ghost.

results.title: A Hero's Journey: The Making of Percy Jackson and the Olympians
results.original_title: A Hero's Journey: The Making of Percy Jackson and the Olympians
results.overview: Alongside a passionate cast and crew, follow Walker Scobell, Leah Sava Jeffries and Aryan Simhadri as they step into worlds fit for gods, battle unforgettable creatures, and perform legendary stunts.

results.title: Sally
results.overview: She escaped one nightmare, only to end up in another . . .

results.title: Space Gardens
results.overview: Music and image merge in this visual spectacle for the first video clip of Paranoia. The psychedelic images and editing combine perfectly to provide a painterly style to a song that invites the listener to dream.

results.title: Lakeview
results.overview: A queer ensemble comedy set over a weekend at the lake house of a group of lifelong friends

results.title: Aux Réformés
results.overview: It’s winter, and Clem needs to sell her fan, make some money and head out to dinner with her mother. But in the middle of the hustle there was a city.

results.title: 73 Seconds
results.overview: It's 1986, Shannon Crane means to be bound for a future she cannot know, on a day filled with possibility and hope. In her 7th grade class, Shannon has to reckon with the ordinary calamity of being herself after a simultaneous incident of being bullied, is caught between the extraordinary catastrophic event of the space challenger disaster, leaving a debris of searching, questioning.
